decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-177 MODIFY that replaces mathematical scaling with optical drawing, establishes the alphabet relationship and extended right arm, and removes the obsolete scale-derived attributes.
The source changes geometric derivation of the second V but does not change the deferred champagne-metal treatment, its material qualities, or its application sequence.

Optically matching the second V's extended arm does not make it a literal copy of the Hero V terminal; the existing rule reserving the exact expressive terminal gesture for the Hero V and É accent remains valid.

The source redirects construction of the second V before composition work resumes but does not necessarily change the deferred composition's kerning, baseline, internal-letter scale, or hierarchy rules.
The instruction to reset around the original Hero V reaffirms the candidate's existing approved and locked master geometry rather than changing it.
The source applies the new optical-construction direction to the second V; the remaining letterforms already retain their custom, cohesive architectural requirements unchanged.
The desired cohesive and timeless result is consistent with the existing brand-expression state and introduces no necessary change to its current attributes.
Changing how the second V is constructed does not alter the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
